# Verovo

> Buyer-side AI service charge and delivery verification. Independent workflows with explicit criteria; local tools and sample measurement runs are free. Enterprise scope and commercial acceptance remain under validation. Last reviewed: 2026-10-31.

## Start here

- [Website](https://roy-tong.github.io/verovo/): overview and local quickstart
- [Services](https://roy-tong.github.io/verovo/services.html): free measurement-run scope, inputs and turnaround
- [FAQ（中文）](https://roy-tong.github.io/verovo/faq.html): Chinese answers to common queries (AI bill checking, API cost recount, open-source reconciliation tools, AI-support billing disputes) with sourced numbers; FAQPage structured data
- [Tool bill coverage](https://roy-tong.github.io/verovo/tools.html): cataloged tool billing models for buyer tasks; provider work is a conditional extension. Cataloged is not live-validated.
- [Healthcheck](https://github.com/roy-tong/verovo/blob/main/healthcheck/README.md): CLI 0.9.0, local session checks, sharing and supported commands
- [SDK](https://github.com/roy-tong/verovo/blob/main/sdk/README.md): Provider SDK, independently versioned
- [Release notes](https://roy-tong.github.io/verovo/releases.html): independent package versions and dated releases

## Measurement and evidence

- [Core](https://github.com/roy-tong/verovo/blob/main/standard/CORE.md): objects, grains and invariants
- [Metrics](https://github.com/roy-tong/verovo/blob/main/standard/METRICS.md): metric contracts
- [VSS-1](https://github.com/roy-tong/verovo/blob/main/standard/SETTLEMENT.md): settlement statement semantics
- [Quality](https://github.com/roy-tong/verovo/blob/main/standard/QUALITY.md): evidence and claim discipline
- [Conformance pack](https://github.com/roy-tong/verovo/blob/main/conformance/pack/README.md): supported checks and fixture requirements
- [Claims index](https://roy-tong.github.io/verovo/claims.html): dated reproductions, corrections and upstream responses
- [Vocabularies](https://github.com/roy-tong/verovo/blob/main/registry/vocabularies.yaml): canonical enums
- [Metric registry](https://github.com/roy-tong/verovo/blob/main/registry/metrics.yaml): machine-readable contracts

- [Commercial scope](https://github.com/roy-tong/verovo/blob/main/docs/commercial-narrative.md): buyer tasks, provider incentives, partners and open-source boundaries

## Product definition and buyer review

- [Product definition](https://github.com/roy-tong/verovo/blob/main/docs/product-definition.md): buyer-first charges and delivery, independent workflows; provider extensions need a concrete transaction.
- [Buyer review guide](https://github.com/roy-tong/verovo/blob/main/docs/buyer-review.md): main-preview local criteria and JSON evidence; separate verdicts, hashes and offline reports. Not in v0.9.0.
- [Synthetic buyer report](https://roy-tong.github.io/verovo/examples/buyer-review.html): charge match, unmet delivery requirement and missing evidence, kept separate.

## Service and evidence limits

Analysis runs locally. Sharing is a user choice after inspection. Existing sample-based measurement runs are free with their published scope. Enterprise charge/delivery reviews require a concrete task, agreed scope and any individually agreed fee; no fixed price or recovery guarantee is published. Delivery review does not require a billing error. Rule applicability and source truth require human review.

Summary counts support interpretation, not guaranteed root-cause diagnosis. Core FMT-002 does not verify token/cache semantics, invoice amounts or pricing accuracy. Missing evidence remains UNPROVABLE. Technical findings and synthetic fixtures are not customer value or paid-demand proof.
